title: AuthProvider::auth_header clones String on every request
description: auth_header() returns Option<(&'static str, String)>. BearerAuth and BasicAuth pre-compute the credential string at construction but must .clone() it on every call (fetch_session, call, upload_blob, download_blob, subscribe_events). The clone is not gratuitous — the owned return type mandates it — but the trait API is the root cause. Idiomatic Rust would return Cow<'_, str> so pre-computed credentials (BearerAuth, BasicAuth) return Borrowed without allocating, and dynamic credentials (hypothetical custom impls) can still return Owned. As-is, every single HTTP request allocates a new String for the auth header even when the credential is constant.
